t: This is the Readymoney Drinking Fountain, sometimes called the Parsee Fountain, a Grade II listed structure halfway along the Broad Walk on the east side of Regent's Park. It stands close to the park's highest point, in an open area with few trees, so you can see it from far across the park. It is named for Sir Cowasji Jehangir Readymoney, a Parsi community leader, philanthropist and industrialist of Bombay, whom it commemorates. Robert Keirle designed it.
